text: After 25 years, it was time for a home makeover.  I chose Beauty Kiss for my flooring. We chose CoreTec vinyl plank flooring for most of the house and carpet for the bedrooms. I could not be happier.  The techs are great and hardworking.  The lead tech, Adolpho, would let me decide how to proceed where there were options. The company rep, Mike, helped us make good decisions based on years of flooring installations and product awareness. We openly discussed our needs and the durability of all of our flooring choices. The 4 person crew moved along like a well oiled machine. My advice to anyone wanting to replace their flooring is  to choose the correct products with the help of a professional, not a salesperson and prepare for the technicians to have a nice open workspace. My techs were appreciative of their "office" being ready for business. Thanks to all who helped us. Mike, Adolpho, Ian, Poncho and Ulysses.

It was great to work with Mike through the selection process.  He was very friendly and helpful in explaining options to meet our needs and budget.  The installation crew did a superb job.  They obviously are very skilled at their work.   They were courteous and arrived each day when they said they would.  They cleaned up thoroughly at the end of each day.  And we appreciated the communication as the job progressed as well as at end of each day that they let us know the plan for the next day.  We are super happy with the results.
Mike and his team were amazing to work with.  Great selection.  Love our new carpet.  Installers were efficient, courteous, quality installers.  Very happy with Beauty-Kiss.  Thanks Mike and team!
The store is great--items neatly organized make selections easy.  Very customer-service oriented.  Happy with the products!
HORRIBLE.

It's been one year and I'm still trying to get my floor fixed. They show up late, show up without the materials they need, or just try put to a bandaid on the problem.  Now after many visits, they recognized that they placed the wrong underlay beneath the planks. If the job was done right the first time, I wouldn't have this problem. Danny my sales rep was not helpful and seemed very annoyed when I told him I still had problems. Definitely not worth the Costco reference or affiliation.  They had to remove the entire floor because the original padding under the floor was the wrong one. The soft padding allowed for the boards to bend and they ended up breaking. They replaced the soft with shiny firm underlay seen in the upper half of the picture.
beware.. we are now taking them to small claims court .. the laminite  floors in all 4 room stated to buckle within a month..  see photos on yelp..

I am now a day away from a week and I have maybe 10 percent left of lashes. I reached out to the owner about this issue and never heard back from them. I get the thicker application so it is extremely noticeable when you start losing them at a record pace. It is just very disappointing that they do not want to stand behind their services. I enjoyed supporting a small business but after this visit I will not be back nor recommend them to anyone.
